item.title: OpenAI adds College Planner and study tools to ChatGPT for Teens
item.description:
OpenAI adds College Planner and study tools to ChatGPT for Teens

OpenAI is expanding its ChatGPT for Teens mode—first launched in August with safeguards and break reminders—by adding a College Planner tool and new studying features.

🔍 Overview

ChatGPT’s new College Planner will help users keep track of application and financial‑aid deadlines, while additional study‑related updates let teens upload multiple photos on iOS and generate flashcards from notes.

🧩 How it works

  • College Planner – “College Planner brings together application requirements, deadlines, tasks, and financial‑aid steps for schools on a student’s list in one plan,” OpenAI says. Students can return to the plan, update progress, use the timeline to plan ahead, and ask ChatGPT questions such as “what a requirement means” or “how to get started.”
  • iOS multi‑photo capture – Users can now use a continuous, multi‑photo capture to upload a bunch of photos at once and then turn them into one PDF.
  • Flashcard generator – ChatGPT will also be able to make flashcards that can be generated from a user’s notes.

⚙️ Key details

  • Target audience: students in grades 10 through 12 planning to attend a four‑year college in the United States.
  • The mode was introduced in August with built‑in safeguards and break reminders.
  • OpenAI claims that, on average, teens spend under 15 minutes a day using ChatGPT.

🚀 Availability

  • The College Planner feature will arrive “soon” according to OpenAI.
  • The new studying tools are already available to iOS users.

💡 Why it matters

The updates come shortly after Common Sense Media labeled ChatGPT for Teens an “unacceptable risk,” noting that the AI tool “still does kids’ homework” and does not send alerts to parents when it should. OpenAI’s addition of structured planning and study aids aims to address concerns while keeping teen usage brief.

📊 Feature Summary

Feature What it does
College Planner Brings together application requirements, deadlines, tasks, and financial‑aid steps for schools on a student’s list; lets students track progress, plan ahead, and ask ChatGPT questions
Multi‑photo capture (iOS) Allows continuous capture of multiple photos and converts them into a single PDF
Flashcard generator Generates flashcards from a user’s notes

#OpenAI #ChatGPT #CollegePlanner #EducationTech

Source: ChatGPT is getting college planning tools

item.title: Odoo 20 Introduces Credit-Based AI Agents with Expanded Capabilities
item.description:
Odoo 20 Introduces Credit-Based AI Agents with Expanded Capabilities

Odoo 20’s release notes put AI front‑and‑center, marking the first Odoo version where AI features—including agents, image generation, and the website assistant—run on purchased credits.

📝 Overview

  • AI is the headline of Odoo 20, but it is now a paid feature.
  • Every AI‑related capability in Odoo 20 operates on a credit‑based model according to the official release notes.

⚙️ New Agent Capabilities

  • Agents are no longer simple chatbots; they can directly create and update records on your behalf.
  • While previewing a file, an agent can answer questions about its contents without you describing the file.
  • Agents display live status updates (e.g., pulling data, checking a record, drafting) instead of a generic “AI is thinking” message.
  • They can be triggered by automated or scheduled actions, enabling workflow execution without opening a chat window.
  • Agents can self‑adjust to better serve their use cases, though the mechanics are not detailed.
  • If an agent reaches its maximum tool‑call limit, it prompts the user for confirmation before continuing.
  • Interactive responses let agents request permission or offer suggestions via clickable buttons.
  • Additional functions include:
    • Filtering view data by time periods such as weeks or quarters.
    • Reprocessing sources to use the latest version of a file.
    • Sending and receiving files directly within a chat.

🧩 Terminology Shift

  • The collections of instructions and tools that define an agent’s behavior, previously called “Topics,” are now termed “Skills.”
  • The underlying configuration remains unchanged; existing topic configurations carry over.
  • The rename frames the concept as a specific capability rather than a loose conversation context.

🔌 Technical Integration

  • Odoo now supports connecting to your database via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), an open standard for linking software to external tools and data sources.
  • No pre‑built third‑party MCP integrations are shipped; the feature provides a standardized connection point for IT teams.

🌐 AI Website Assistant Enhancements

  • The assistant can create new webpages from a description.
  • It can edit a site’s menu—creating, renaming, moving, nesting, reordering, or deleting items.
  • It can create or edit webforms.
  • It can draw inspiration from other websites, pull data from your own records (e.g., products, events), and add interactive elements such as counters, toggles, tabs, or animations.
  • For images, the assistant can source from Unsplash or generate them directly.

📊 Capability Summary

Capability What it Does
Direct record creation & update Agents can directly create and update records on your behalf
File preview Q&A Agents answer questions about a file while you preview it
Live status updates Agents show specific, live updates on their actions, replacing generic messages
Automated/scheduled execution Agents can be summoned by automated and scheduled actions within workflows
Self‑adjustment Agents can update themselves to better serve their use cases
Tool‑call limit safeguard Agents prompt for user confirmation when reaching maximum tool call limit
Interactive responses Agents request permission or offer suggestions via clickable buttons
Time‑period filtering Agents filter by time period when building views (weeks, quarters, etc.)
Source reprocessing Agents can reprocess sources to use the most up‑to‑date file version
File exchange Agents can send and receive files directly inside a chat
Skills (formerly Topics) Instruction collections renamed to “Skills”; configuration unchanged
MCP database connection Odoo can connect to your database via the Model Context Protocol
AI Website Assistant features Create webpages, edit menus, create/edit webforms, use external inspiration, add interactive elements, source or generate images

💡 Why It Matters

  • The shift to a credit‑based model signals Odoo’s move toward monetizing AI functionality.
  • Expanded agent capabilities aim to embed AI more deeply into everyday business processes, reducing the need for manual data entry and enabling richer, context‑aware interactions.
  • The introduction of MCP connectivity lays groundwork for future integrations with external tools, offering a standardized approach rather than custom one‑offs.
  • Renaming “Topics” to “Skills” clarifies the intent of agent configurations as defined capabilities.

#Odoo20 #AIAgents #EnterpriseSoftware
